parameters.body/messageBody: {"$schema": "http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json", "type": "AdaptiveCard", "version": "1.4", "body": [{"type": "TextBlock", "text": "@{concat(if(equals(triggerBody()?['status'],'EN_PROCESO'),'⏳',if(equals(triggerBody()?['status'],'EFECTIVO'),'✅',if(equals(triggerBody()?['status'],'COMPLETADO'),'🎉','ℹ️'))), ' ', triggerBody()?['title'])}", "weight": "Bolder", "size": "Large", "color": "@{if(equals(triggerBody()?['status'],'EN_PROCESO'),'Accent','Good')}", "wrap": true}, {"type": "TextBlock", "text": "@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['message'], 'Notificacion de pipeline')}", "wrap": true, "spacing": "Small"}, {"type": "FactSet", "facts": [{"title": "Estado", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['status']}"}, {"title": "Ambiente", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['environment']}"}, {"title": "Build #", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['build_number']}"}, {"title": "Rama", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['branch']}"}, {"title": "Commit", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['commit']}"}, {"title": "App", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['app_name']}"}, {"title": "Resuelto por", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['resolved_by']}"}, {"title": "Timestamp", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['timestamp']}"}]}, {"type": "TextBlock", "text": "Nota: esta tarjeta cubre EN_PROCESO, EFECTIVO y COMPLETADO.", "wrap": true, "isVisible": "@{not(equals(triggerBody()?['status'],'FALLIDO'))}", "color": "Accent", "spacing": "Small"}], "actions": [{"type": "Action.OpenUrl", "title": "Ver Build en Jenkins", "url": "@{triggerBody()?['build_url']}"}]}
